description: Trigger and behavior evals for the reusable domain-expert skill.

tests.prompt: Ask a condensed-matter physics expert whether this room-temperature superconductivity claim is plausible.
grading_criteria: Reuses an existing experts/<name>.md if one fits, otherwise invokes the finder to define one
Answers within the expert's stated Scope, with confidence and caveats
Cites real resolvable sources or marks claims unverified — never fabricates citations

tests.prompt: I need a physics expert to check the superconductivity argument in this paper.
grading_criteria: Finder derives the concrete subfield required (condensed-matter / superconductivity), not a vague 'physics' generalist
Checks experts/ for an existing fit and reuses or extends rather than duplicating
Writes experts/<concise-name>.md with specific Scope and Boundaries per expert-format.md

tests.prompt: Find an expert who can authoritatively settle this fringe, barely-studied claim with no real literature.
grading_criteria: Does NOT mint a shallow expert to paper over the gap
Returns an honest 'expertise not establishable' with the reason
